purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/seikyu) system - specifically triple-burden and area public expense receipt list (161,162,163,164,165 receipt types)
purpose.summary: SEIKYU2407 is a batch report program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It generates a list/summary of receipts for local government public expense subsidies (chihou kouhi), handling triple-burden and area-specific receipt categories. It reads an indexed file of aggregated receipt data, processes insurance and public expense combinations, and prints formatted output.

notable_features: REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
OCCURS tables for insurance combinations and public expense targets
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Program option handling for print order and target public expense codes
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing all Japanese text to appear as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 127597 bytes (2917 lines total). Content is clearly production ORCA system code with multi-year revision history. No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations - amounts stored as PIC 9 fields.
